name: I-meningitis
tagline: Intamo eqinileyo, intloko ebuhlungu kakhulu, urhashalala emfusa.

urgent.heading: Ingxamisekile — yiya esibhedlele ngoku
urgent.primary_message: I-meningitis yebhaktiriya ingabulala ngaphakathi kweeyure. Musa ukulinda zonke iimpawu — yiya esibhedlele ngoko nangoko.
red_flags: urhashalala ebomvu-mfusa ENGAPHELIYO xa icinezelwa ngeglasi
Intamo eqinileyo — akakwazi ukuchukumisa isilevu esifubeni
Intloko ebuhlungu kakhulu ehamba nefiva nokugabha
Indawo ethambileyo entlokweni yosana igqabhukile, kunye nefiva nokwala ukutya

what_is_it.heading: I-meningitis ngamazwi alula
what_is_it.lede: I-meningitis lusulelo lweemeninges — amaleko akhuselayo ajikeleze ubuchopho nomnqonqo. I-meningitis yebhaktiriya yenye yezifo ezosulelayo ezibulala ngokukhawuleza kakhulu.
paragraphs: Uninzi lwe-meningitis lubangelwa yintsholongwane okanye ibhaktiriya. I-meningitis yentsholongwane idla ngokuba buthathaka kwaye iphile ngokwayo. I-meningitis yebhaktiriya yimeko engxamisekileyo yokwenene — inokubulala umntu osempilweni ngaphakathi kweeyure kwaye idinga ii-antibiotic ngokukhawuleza.

Ngaphandle, akunakwenzeka ukwahlula ezi ntlobo zimbini ngokuthembeka. Yiyo loo nto naliphi na ityala elikrokrelwayo kufuneka liphathwe njengebhaktiriya de kuboniswe okwahlukileyo. UMzantsi Afrika uneenkqubo zogonyo ngokuchasene neentlobo eziyingozi kakhulu.

items.headline: Ibulala ngeeyure
items.body: I-meningitis yebhaktiriya ingasuka kuphawu lokuqala iye ekufeni ngaphantsi kweeyure ezingama-24. Isantya sonyango sibaluleke kakhulu.

items.headline: Inokuthintelwa ngogonyo
items.body: Izitofu zasimahla zabantwana eMzantsi Afrika (Hib, Pneumococcal, Meningococcal) zithintela ezona ntlobo ziyingozi. Zifumane ngexesha.

items.headline: Umngcipheko kubantu abasondeleyo
items.body: Isasazeka ngokukhohlela, ukuthimla, ukuncamisana okanye ukwabelana ngeziselo. Abantu abasondeleyo basenokunikwa ii-antibiotic njengokhuseleko.

items.headline: Uvavanyo lweglasi
items.body: Cinezela iglasi ecacileyo phezu kwerhashalala. Ukuba amachokoza awapheli phantsi koxinzelelo — yiya ngqo esibhedlele.

pull_quote.text: Thembela kwimvakalelo yakho. Ukuba kukho into evakala imbi kakhulu — ngakumbi emntwaneni — musa ukulinda uluhlu olupheleleyo lweempawu. Yiya esibhedlele. I-meningitis ingabulala ngaphambi kokuba zonke iimpawu zivele.

signs.heading: Into omawuyijonge
signs.lede: Iimpawu zinokuqala njengeflu, zize zibe mandundu ngokukhawuleza. Iimpawu eziqhelekileyo zisenokungaveli ngolandelelwano olufanayo — okanye zingaveli kwaphela kwiintsana nabantwana abancinci.

items.title: Abantu abadala nabantwana abadala
items.description: Ifiva ephezulu, intloko ebuhlungu kakhulu, intamo eqinileyo (akakwazi ukuchukumisa isilevu esifubeni), ukunganyamezeli ukukhanya, isicaphucaphu okanye ukugabha, ukudideka okanye ukozela.

items.title: urhashalala emfusa
items.description: Amachokoza amancinci abomvu-mfusa okanye amabala abonakala njengamabala okulimala. Asasazeka ngokukhawuleza. Awapheli xa ecinezelwa ngeglasi — le yimeko engxamisekileyo.

items.title: Iintsana nabantwana abancinci
items.description: Ukukhala okuphezulu okungaqhelekanga, ukwala ukutya, umzimba uthambe kakhulu okanye uqine kakhulu, indawo ethambileyo entloko igqabhukile, ulusu lunamabala okanye luphaphathekile, ifiva enezandla neenyawo ezibandayo.

items.title: Izandla neenyawo ezibandayo kuqala
items.description: Izandla neenyawo ziba bandayo ngelixa umzimba ushushu, intlungu enkulu emilenzeni, nolusu oluphaphathekileyo ngokungaqhelekanga zinokuba ziimpawu zokuqala phambi kwerhashalala okanye intamo eqinileyo.

spreads.heading: I-meningitis isasazeka njani
yes: Ukuncamisana okanye unxibelelwano olusondeleyo ixesha elide
Ukwabelana ngeekomityi, iibhotile zamanzi, iicigarette okanye izixhobo zokutya
Ukuhlala kwiindawo ezixineneyo — iindawo zokuhlala zabafundi, iikampu zomkhosi, iintolongo
no: Unxibelelwano oluqhelekileyo njengokuxhawulana okanye ukuba kwigumbi elinye
Izihlalo zangasese, amachibi okuqubha okanye izibambo zeminyango

prevention.heading: Ungazikhusela njani wena nosapho lwakho
prevention.lede: Izitofu zikhusela kwiintlobo eziyingozi kakhulu ze-meningitis yebhaktiriya. Zisimahla kwiikliniki zikarhulumente kubantwana, kwaye ziyacetyiswa kwabanye abantu abadala abasemngciphekweni.

items.title: Izitofu zasimahla zabantwana
items.description: Hib kwiiveki ezi-6, 10, 14. Pneumococcal kwiiveki ezi-6, 14, iinyanga ezi-9. Meningococcal apho kuboniswe khona. Landela ishedyuli yaseMzantsi Afrika.

items.title: Amaqela asemngciphekweni ophezulu
items.description: Abafundi baseyunivesithi kwiindawo zokuhlala, abasebenzi abatsha bomkhosi, abahambi ukuya kwibhanti ye-meningitis eAfrika okanye eHajj — buza ugqirha wakho ngesitofu se-Meningococcal ACWY.

items.title: Ukuba umntu osondeleyo uyagula
items.description: Amalungu endlu nabantu abasondeleyo kumntu one-meningitis yebhaktiriya badla ngokunikwa ii-antibiotic zokuthintela yiPublic Health. Zithathe — ziyasebenza.

items.title: Yazi kwangoko — yenza ngokukhawuleza
items.description: Ukwazi iimpawu kusindisa ubomi. Thembela kwimvakalelo yakho. Ukuba kukho into ebonakala imbi kakhulu, yiya esibhedlele.

items.fact: Iintsana, abakwishumi elivisayo nabantu abatsha basemngciphekweni ophezulu, kodwa ingahlasela nakweyiphi na iminyaka. Uqhambuko kwiindawo zokuhlala zabafundi luqhelekile.

items.myth: Ukuba urhashalala isaphela xa ndiyicinezelile, ayisiyo meningitis.
items.fact: Ekuqaleni kwe-meningitis urhashalala isenokuphela. Ukuba ezinye iimpawu zikhona — intloko ebuhlungu, ifiva, intamo eqinileyo — yiya esibhedlele nokuba kunjalo.
I-meningitis yebhaktiriya idinga ii-antibiotic ezifakwa emthanjeni esibhedlele, kunye nokujongwa. Ii-antibiotic zeepilisi kuphela azonelanga.
Izitofu zikhusela kwiimbangela zebhaktiriya ezixhaphakileyo. Azibangeli esi sifo. Izitofu zeshedyuli yabantwana zikhuselekile kwaye zisindisa ubomi.

items.title: Yenza uvavanyo lweglasi
items.description: Cinezela icala leglasi ecacileyo ngokuqinileyo phezu kwerhashalala. Ukuba amachokoza ahlala ebonakala ngeglasi — yiya esibhedlele ngoku.

items.title: Tsalela umnxeba ku-10177 okanye uye ngqo kwisebe likaxakeka
items.description: Yithi 'ndikrokrela i-meningitis' xa ufika ukuze ubonwe ngoko nangoko. Musa ukulinda appointment ye-GP.

items.title: Qaphela ukuba iimpawu ziqale nini
items.description: Ixesha libalulekile. Xelela iqela lasesibhedlele ukuba ifiva, intloko ebuhlungu, urhashalala okanye utshintsho kwindlela aziphatha ngayo luqale nini.

items.title: Musa ukulinda zonke iimpawu
items.description: Ezona mpawu zithathu ziqhelekileyo — ifiva, intamo eqinileyo nentloko ebuhlungu — zisenokungaveli zonke kunye. Enye yazo yanele ukuba uhlolwe.

items.title: Xelela abantu abasondeleyo
items.description: Nabani na owabelane ngendlu, ikomityi okanye ukwanga kwiveki edlulileyo kufuneka aqhagamshelane nePublic Health ukuze afumane ingcebiso. Kunganikwa ii-antibiotic zokuthintela.

get_help.heading: Ngubani omawumfowunele ngoku
get_help.lede: I-meningitis yebhaktiriya ekrokrelwayo yenye yezifo ezimbalwa apho 'yiya esibhedlele ngoku' iyimpendulo efanelekileyo — nange-3am, nokuba awuqinisekanga.
